# langsmith_info_health (Data Source)

Reports health of the LangSmith instance. Most useful on a self-hosted deployment, where storage headroom is the operator's problem — on Cloud the value reflects infrastructure you do not manage.

This is a point-in-time reading taken during `terraform plan` and `apply`; it is not a monitor, and Terraform will not re-evaluate it between runs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_info_health" "example" {}

output "clickhouse_disk_free_pct" {
  value = data.langsmith_info_health.example.clickhouse_disk_free_pct
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `clickhouse_disk_free_pct` (Number) Percentage of ClickHouse disk still free. Null when the deployment does not report it.
